name: Eat With Sinners
overview: The Scriptures reveal that Jesus intentionally associated with publicans and sinners, dining with them openly as recorded in Matthew 9:10 and Mark 2:15. His willingness to eat and drink with those considered outcasts led to criticism from religious leaders, as seen in Mark 2:16 and Matthew 11:19, highlighting His mission to reach the lost rather than to conform to societal expectations. This fellowship demonstrates Christ's grace and desire to bring sinners into repentance, emphasizing that true wisdom is found in His redemptive approach to those in need of mercy.
